frequency_question: What proportion of central bank special reserve ratio implementations successfully meet specific date-bound notification criteria when the policy intent exists?
membership_rule: Members are central bank policy announcements introducing temporary or incremental reserve ratio frameworks. Excluded are standard scheduled reserve requirement changes and verbal policy signals without formal notification.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 2 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 2 named instances of incremental reserve ratio deployment by the RBI; both met formal notification criteria without technical ambiguity.
known_gaps: Small sample size for this specific named instrument (iCRR), though standard monetary policy notifications have near 100% formal compliance once decided.
skeleton: Central bank policy tool announcements meeting formal gazette/notification requirements versus total announced intent.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 2 policy execution instances where the substantive tool was deployed.
validity_reason: Central bank notification procedures and legal frameworks for gazette announcements evolve slowly over decades.
